title: An investigation regarding the Jalen Hurts situation has not begun

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: An investigation regarding the Jalen Hurts situation has not begun
sources.description: The return of Eagles quarterback Jalen Hurts to the team's facility on Wednesday is a reminder that plenty of questions remain regarding the decisions made as to his health before flying to London with a blood clot in his leg, playing in London with a blood clot in his leg, and flying back from London with a blood clot in his leg.
